title: Emerald Edge
wikitext:
The [[Emerald Edge]] has a long blade made up of two curves with the lower, smaller one connecting to an orb. It has a very similar look to the [[Cerulean Edge]] and [[Violet Edge]].

==Dye==
[[Dye]] affects the entire sword. The handle's wrapping and the orb will dye to the color specified while the rest of the sword will dye differently. The only exception to this are black, gray, silver and white dye which will dye the entire sword to a similar color. The default color can be closely replicated using yellow dye.
